title: Erasing the last sparse cell
statement: Let $w$ be a finite list of possibly blank Boolean cells and let $b$ be a possibly blank Boolean cell. Blanking cell $|w|$ of the sparse tape determined by $w$ followed by $b$ gives the sparse tape determined by $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a finite list of possibly blank Boolean cells
$b$ is a possibly blank Boolean cell
replaced:
Let $w$ be a finite list of possibly blank cells and $b$ a possibly blank entry.
Blanking position $|w|$ of the sparse tape of $w$ extended by $b$ yields exactly
the sparse tape of $w$; this holds even when $b$ is itself blank.
